name: Firelight
blurb: An evening of folk, song and stories with Burton Folk Club: music that's been passed down and songs still being written. Warm, welcoming, and open to all.
people: An intergenerational night with Burton Folk Club: regulars, families and first-timers sharing songs and stories. We'll be gathering Burton's music stories on the night.

name: Winter Sounds
blurb: The moment the community gathers for winter, and the launch night for Founding Membership of The Space Between. Live music, warm drinks, and the chance to be part of what comes next.
people: The whole community together for winter, and the night Founding Membership launches: the people who'll help make the case for what comes next.

name: New Year Community Sing
blurb: No experience needed, no audition, no pressure. Just voices together to start the year. Come as you are.
people: Free, warm and low-pressure, with hot drinks and Circularity.org's community. Made for anyone who's never been to one of our events: no experience, no ticket, just come and sing.

name: Love Your Local
blurb: A hop between Burton's live music venues on one night: local artists, local pubs, one wristband. A reminder that the town already has a music scene worth keeping.
people: You choose who plays. A night that puts Burton's own musicians, and the people who back them, centre stage.
access: Varies by venue. Details with each listing.

name: Family Music Discovery Day
blurb: Instruments to try, musicians to meet, and music to make together. A free Saturday morning for families to find out what live music feels like from the inside.
people: For families and children, with TURBO and Burton & South Derbyshire College students: an instrument 'petting zoo' and taster workshops, so nobody needs to call themselves a music fan to join in.
access: Step-free. Baby-changing available. BSL on request.

name: Global Sounds
blurb: Music from across the world, made in and around Burton. A celebration of the town's cultures and the musicians who carry them.
people: Co-curated with community ambassadors and Burton Caribbean Association: music from Burton's many cultures, chosen by the communities it belongs to.
venue: Burton Library or Burton Caribbean Association (venue to be confirmed)
access: Full access details confirmed with the venue and published here. BSL on request.

name: Music in the Market
blurb: Live music in the heart of Burton's market: free, outdoors, and impossible to miss. A Saturday morning that sounds different.
people: Free pop-up sets where people already are, so shoppers, families and passers-by meet local music in the middle of town.

name: Summer Park Sessions
blurb: A long afternoon in the park with local artists across multiple stages. Bring a blanket. Bring the kids. Bring whoever needs a good afternoon.
people: A big outdoor get-together for everyone, and the start of our summer Loyalty Passport: the more you come, the more you're part of it.
access: Outdoor event. Full access details published with the listing. BSL on request.

name: Youth Takeover
blurb: The stage belongs to Burton's young musicians. A night programmed by and for young people: the next generation of the town's music scene.
people: Programmed by young people, for young people. Our Youth Programming Panel runs the night, from who's booked to who's on stage.
venue: Burton Library, Burton Caribbean Association or Burton & South Derbyshire College (venue to be confirmed)
access: Full access details confirmed with the venue and published here. BSL on request.

name: Community Music Trail
blurb: The year ends, and the case is made. A trail of music across Burton's spaces, charities and community venues, one month before the next Sonic Boom Festival.
people: A town-wide trail across Burton's venues, passport in hand, bringing the whole year's community together ahead of the 2027 festival.
access: Varies by venue. Details with each listing.
